purpose: Adapters for a bounded Oxford palaeobotanical teaching-slide catalogue, newly located and recovered historical MNCN preparation layers, a nineteenth-century Madrid school teaching collection, and item-level W. M. Bale hydroid microslides at Museums Victoria.
guards: Do not turn pre-1912 acquisition counts into nineteenth-century counts without item-level dating.
Keep newly located mixed historical/current preparation batches as mixed until inventory records isolate the historical subset.
Preserve uncertain historical assignments explicitly, including MNCN sponge slides whose nineteenth-century attribution rests on label form, staining or numerical annotations rather than dates.
Keep episcopic projection slides, lantern slides and other glass projection media separate from microscopic preparations even when one teaching museum preserves both.
For type-slide databases, use identification, collection and preparation dates where available rather than treating a taxon author year by itself as the object date.

adapters.institution_scope: Oxford University Herbaria OXF Palaeobotox collection
adapters.target: BRAHMS catalogue of 115 palaeobotanical microscope slides with slide images and notebook cross-links
adapters.promotion_rule: Harvest slide-level names, images, notes, makers and acquisition evidence to isolate the late-nineteenth-century teaching subset; preserve nine apparently lost slides and the later 1929 Hemingway tranche separately.

adapters.institution_scope: Museo Nacional de Ciencias Naturales CSIC Arthropod Collection
adapters.target: official arthropod collection page and inventory/database discovery for the recently located >10000 preparation batch
adapters.promotion_rule: Retain >10000 as the newly located mixed batch state and separate late-nineteenth-century preparations from the unspecified current-author component before historical counting.

adapters.institution_scope: Museo Nacional de Ciencias Naturales CSIC historical sponge collection
adapters.target: 2017 Graellsia collection study and underlying MNCN Invertebrate Collection database records
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture the roughly 350 late-nineteenth-century samples and >90% slide proportion, label/staining fields, Santander and Naples subgroups, and 55 doubtful datings; keep the >400 late-19th/early-20th recovery state separate.

adapters.institution_scope: IES San Isidro Madrid historical museum and Natural History Cabinet
adapters.target: official EducaMadrid museum page and future cabinet catalogue
adapters.promotion_rule: Establish the nineteenth-century microscopic-preparation teaching collection while excluding the separate approximately 300 episcopic glass projection slides and later microscope apparatus; seek item inventory and label-level records.

adapters.institution_scope: Museums Victoria W. M. Bale Collection
adapters.target: public specimen database filtered to W. M. Bale Collection, microslide nature/form and pre-1900 identification/collection dates
adapters.promotion_rule: Enumerate pre-1900 Bale-collection microslides through item records, preserving type status, F registration number, identifier, collector, locality, depth and collection date; exclude later records even when the taxon name was published in the nineteenth century.
